paper_title: Training and Evaluating with Human Label Variation An Empirical Study
caption: Soft accuracy and graphs for a binary classification problem on a single example where the true and the predicted judgement for the positive class is 0.5 and q respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled ‘q’ and two metrics: ‘soft accuracy’ and ‘PO-JSD’. The x-axis is labeled “q”, is linear, spans from 0 to 0.9, and has tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 0.6 to 1.0, and is unlabeled. A blue solid line represents ‘soft accuracy’, starting at approximately 0.62 when q is 0, increasing to 0.92 when q is 0.46, and then decreasing to approximately 0.64 when q is 0.9. An orange solid line represents “PO-JSD”, beginning at approximately 0.78 when q is 0, increasing to approximately 0.97 when q is 0.9, with a steady incline across the x-axis.
